summary: Strengthen PMO governance, risk analysis, and benefits tracking with practical AI applications. Explore the five-day course and course outline.
lede: AI-enabled PMO and portfolio governance helps leaders turn project data into reviewable investment and delivery decisions. For PMO directors, portfolio managers, senior project managers, and transformation leads, the training addresses prioritizing work against capacity, risk, and expected benefits. Participants practise assessing predictive risk signals, modelling resource constraints in Excel, and building benefits-tracking plans while checking data quality and reviewing AI-generated recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and specialists who make or support project, portfolio, and PMO governance decisions, including teams introducing AI-assisted analysis into existing delivery methods.
prerequisites: Practical experience in project delivery, portfolio oversight, PMO operations, or transformation governance is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet exercises; Power BI access is optional for dashboard design discussions. Advanced AI and predictive analytics are covered at an operational application level, not as hands-on model engineering.
